title: CarScout
description: Search used car inventory, check NHTSA recalls, decode VINs, and manage automated search scouts.
summary: Search used car inventory, check NHTSA recalls, decode VINs, and manage automated search scouts.
offersHint: Search used car inventory, check NHTSA recalls, decode VINs, and manage automated search scouts. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.usecarscout.com/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key from usecarscout.com/settings (format: Bearer sk_live_...)

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer API key from usecarscout.com/settings (format: Bearer sk_live_...)

toolsPreview.name: get_market_data
toolsPreview.description: Get current market pricing, recall, and fuel economy data for a specific vehicle by make, model, and year. Useful for understanding fair prices and vehicle history.

toolsPreview.name: check_recalls
toolsPreview.description: Look up NHTSA safety recalls and consumer complaints for a specific vehicle by make, model, and year. Returns recall campaign details and complaint severity data.

toolsPreview.name: decode_vin
toolsPreview.description: Decode a Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) to get make, model, year, body style, engine, transmission, and other vehicle details.
